title: Why Black audiences would not pay to dance
summary: A short exchange on what went on in the back and why dime dances would not work for Black patrons.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You know what I mean? Yeah.
Because you'd be surprised when you go in the back and see what happened.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Well, that's the slow ones that made the slaves slow, slow. Yeah. And everybody get together.

Yeah. But for our people, man, no, they don't go for that. They don't go for no ten cents to dance, man. No. Ain't gonna play. I see. You were talking more about the Sam Morgan or Isaiah Morgan bands.
